camel_example: aliyun dts ConfigureSynchronizationJob --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtsz4ao1dor13d0000 --DataInitialization true --SynchronizationObjects 'DBName_:_dtstestdata_,_TableIncludes_:_TableName_:_customer' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --StructureInitialization true
description_en: Configures a legacy data synchronization task
description_zh: 老版配置数据同步作业
kebab_example: aliyun dts configure-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsz4ao1dor13d0000 --structure-initialization true --data-initialization true --synchronization-objects DBName_:_dtstestdata_,_TableIncludes_:_TableName_:_customer --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureSynchronizationJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的id，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the synchronization task.
Specify a descriptive name that is easy to identify. The name does not need to be unique
parameters.help_zh:
同步任务名称。
建议配置具有业务意义的名称（无唯一性要求），便于后续识别
parameters.name: synchronization_job_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: Forward synchronization.
Reverse: Reverse synchronization.

Default value: Forward.
This parameter takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization and the value is set to Reverse
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，本参数传入Reverse才会生效
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the source instance
parameters.help_zh: 源实例ID
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source instance. Valid values:

RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
Redis: Alibaba Cloud Redis instance.
PolarDB: PolarDB cluster (only MySQL or Oracle-compatible engines are supported).
ECS: Self-managed database hosted on Elastic Compute Service (ECS).
Express: Self-managed database connected over Express Connect.
dg: Self-managed database connected over Database Gateway.
cen: Self-managed database connected over Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

Default value: RDS
parameters.help_zh:
源实例类型，取值为：

RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
Redis：阿里云Redis实例。
PolarDB：阿里云PolarDB集群（仅支持MySQL或兼容Oracle语法的引擎）。
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
Express：通过专线接入的自建数据库。
dg：通过数据库网关DG接入的自建数据库。
cen：通过云企业网CEN接入的自建数据库。

默认取值为RDS
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the source database.
This parameter is available and required only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
源库的IP地址。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The service port number of the source database.
This parameter is available and required only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
源库的数据库服务端口。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The database account of the source database.
This parameter is available and required only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen.
This parameter is not required when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to Redis.
The permissions required for synchronizing different databases vary. For more information, see the corresponding configuration examples in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140954.html
parameters.help_zh:
源库的数据库账号。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为Redis时，本参数无需传入。
同步不同的数据库所需的权限有所差异，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140954.html中对应的配置案例
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account for the source database.
This parameter is required only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
源库数据库账号密码。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the destination instance for synchronization.
When the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute or DataHub, set this parameter to the name of the MaxCompute project or DataHub project.
If the destination instance is an Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB for MySQL database, set this parameter to the cluster ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL database
parameters.help_zh:
同步目标实例的实例ID
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为MaxCompute或DataHub时，本参数传入MaxCompute实例或DataHub的Project名称。
当目标实例为阿里云分析型数据库MySQL版时，传入分析型数据库MySQL版的集群ID
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination instance type. Valid values:

Redis: Alibaba Cloud Redis instance.
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
PolarDB: PolarDB cluster (only MySQL or Oracle-compatible engines are supported).
ECS: Self-managed database hosted on ECS.
Express: Self-managed database connected over Express Connect.
DataHub: DataHub instance.
MaxCompute: MaxCompute instance.
AnalyticDB: AnalyticDB for MySQL 3.0 and 2.0.
Greenplum: AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL.

Default value: RDS
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例类型，取值为：

Redis：阿里云Redis实例。
RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
PolarDB：阿里云PolarDB集群（仅支持MySQL或兼容Oracle语法的引擎）。
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
Express：通过专线接入的本地数据库。
DataHub：阿里云DataHub实例。
MaxCompute：阿里云MaxCompute实例。
AnalyticDB：云原生数据仓库AnalyticDB MySQL  3.0和2.0版本。
Greenplum：云原生数据仓库ADB PostgreSQL版（原分析型数据库PostgreSQL版）。

默认取值为RDS
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the destination database.
This parameter is available and required only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的IP地址。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为Express、dg或cen时，本参数必须传入本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The service port number of the destination database.
This parameter is available and required only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的数据库服务端口。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The database account of the destination database.
The permissions required for synchronizing different databases vary. For more information, see the corresponding configuration examples in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140954.html.
This parameter is required when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen.
This parameter and the DestinationEndpoint.Password parameter are not required when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to RDS and the database engine version is MySQL 5.5 or MySQL 5.6.
This parameter is not required when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to Redis
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的数据库账号。
同步不同的数据库所需的权限有所差异，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140954.html中对应的配置案例。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数必须传入。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为RDS且数据库版本为MySQL 5.5或MySQL 5.6，无需传入本参数和DestinationEndpoint.Password参数。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为Redis时，无需传入本参数
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account for the destination database.

This parameter is required when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to ECS, Express, dg, or cen
parameters.help_zh:
目标库数据库账号密码。

当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、Express、dg或cen时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform initial schema synchronization. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行结构初始化，取值：
true：是。
false：否。

默认取值：true
parameters.name: structure_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform initial full data synchronization. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行全量数据初始化，取值：

true：是。
false：否。

默认取值：true
parameters.name: data_initialization

parameters.help_en: The objects to be synchronized. The value is a JSON string and supports specific regular expressions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141901.html
parameters.help_zh: 同步对象，格式为JSON串且支持一定的正则表达式，详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141901.html
parameters.name: synchronization_objects

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the source ApsaraDB RDS instance belongs.
Specifying this parameter indicates that cross-Alibaba Cloud account data synchronization is executed. You must also specify the SourceEndpoint.Role parameter
parameters.help_zh:
源RDS实例所属的阿里云账号ID。
传入本参数即代表执行跨阿里云账号的数据同步，同时您还需要传入SourceEndpoint.Role参数
parameters.name: source_endpoint_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM role configured for the Alibaba Cloud account to which the source instance belongs.
This parameter is required for cross-account data synchronization. For more information about the permissions required for the role and how to grant the permissions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48468.html
parameters.help_zh:
源实例所属云账号配置的角色名称。
执行跨阿里云账号的数据同步时须传入本参数，该角色所需的权限及授权方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48468.html
parameters.name: source_endpoint_role

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the incremental log table contains partitions defined by the year of the incremental update time. Valid values: true and false.
This parameter is available only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
设置增量日志表是否包含以增量更新时间对应年份信息定义的分区，取值：true或false。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为Maxcompute时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: partition_key_modify_time_year

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the incremental log table contains partitions defined by the month of the incremental update time. Valid values: true and false.
This parameter is available only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
设置增量日志表是否包含以增量更新时间对应月份信息定义的分区，取值：true或false。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为Maxcompute时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: partition_key_modify_time_month

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the incremental log table contains partitions defined by the day of the incremental update time. Valid values: true and false.
This parameter is available only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
设置增量日志表是否包含以增量更新时间对应日期信息定义的分区，取值：true或false。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为Maxcompute时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: partition_key_modify_time_day

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the incremental log table contains partitions defined by the hour of the incremental update time. Valid values: true and false.
This parameter is available only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
设置增量日志表是否包含以增量更新时间对应小时信息定义的分区，取值：true或false。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为Maxcompute时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: partition_key_modify_time_hour

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the incremental log table contains partitions defined by the minute of the incremental update time. Valid values: true and false.

This parameter is available only when the DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
设置增量日志表是否包含以增量更新时间对应分钟信息定义的分区，取值：true或false。

当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为Maxcompute时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: partition_key_modify_time_minute

parameters.help_en:
The reserved parameter for DTS. The value is a JSON string. You can specify this parameter to meet specific requirements, such as whether to automatically start a precheck. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176470.html.
For example, you can use this parameter for data synchronization between Redis Enterprise instances. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155967.html
parameters.help_zh:
DTS预留参数，格式为JSON串，您可以传入本参数实现特殊需求（例如是否自动启动预检查）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176470.html。
如在Redis企业版实例间的数据同步可使用该参数，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155967.html
parameters.name: migration_reserved

parameters.help_en: The synchronization checkpoint
parameters.help_zh: 同步位点
parameters.name: checkpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be deprecated soon
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to which the synchronization objects in the source instance belong
parameters.help_zh: 源实例中的同步对象所属数据库名称
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to which the synchronization objects in the destination instance belong
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例中的同步对象所属数据库名称
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_data_base_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
